title: Visa Moves to Close Meme Coin Credit Card Rewards Loophole
summary: Visa is reportedly moving to prevent meme coin purchases from being categorized as "digital media," a loophole that allowed users to earn credit card rewards. This action follows JP Morgan's efforts to tighten rules around crypto-related transactions. The change aims to curb the use of credit card rewards for speculative meme coin investments.
